The '''Syvris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Al'Nasrl sector/Legends|Al'Nasrl sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system had lifeless planets and moons, excepting the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Syvris/Legends|Syvris]].

A [[Battle of the Syvris system|battle]] occurred in the system during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SE">{{TORcite|type=space|Syvris Evacuation}}</ref>
